candidates.tagline: SiriusXM killed their 800-comedian comedy channel and handed it to one celebrity
candidates.story: In April 2026 SiriusXM shut down Raw Comedy ("Raw Dog"), which featured 800 working comedians who earned royalties from airplay, and replaced it with a 24/7 channel curated by Sebastian Maniscalco; by September 2026, the artist count had plunged from 812 to 275, prompting a public backlash from Patton Oswalt, Margaret Cho, Michelle Wolf, and others.
candidates.why_funny: A company that sells 'comedy radio' redesigned their main comedy channel so it now features fewer than a third as many comedians.
candidates.alt: Sebastian Maniscalco, the stand-up comedian whose exclusive SiriusXM channel replaced the Raw Dog Comedy channel that had featured hundreds of working-class comedians

candidates.tagline: Nissin priced their Halloween noodles at $1.18 and the matching coffin at $3,999
candidates.story: Nissin Foods launched Vampire Cup Noodles — garlic chicken ramen that turns blood-red when you add hot water — for $1.18 at Walmart, then teamed up with Titan Casket to offer a custom Cup Noodles–branded collector's coffin, complete with blood-drip logo and 'It's To Die For' embroidered inside the lid, for $3,999.
candidates.why_funny: A $1.18 instant noodle product now has a $3,999 optional accessory — a 3,400× markup to enjoy your soup in a branded coffin.
candidates.alt: Three red-labeled Cup Noodles Vampire Noodles cups displayed inside an open maroon collector's casket branded with the Cup Noodles blood-drip logo
